title: Conditions manifest
description: One row per evaluable scored result — i.e. one leaderboard cell. A condition is the unit that OWNS the metrics. It is produced by aggregating + thresholding + (optionally) verifying the first N passes of a single proposer pool (cross-config fusion was never executed, so the reference is a simple prefix, not a many-to-many lineage table). Aggregation 'orphans' like greedy/wbf/consensus/verified ARE conditions.

run_id.description: Foreign key to the runs manifest.

architecture.description: The precise architecture of this evaluable result (the run carries only a coarse family).

aggregation.description: How the source passes were combined into one scored detection set. 'none' = a single-pass result.

proposer_pool.description: Identifier of the proposer config whose passes this condition draws from. The condition consumes the first n_passes of this pool. Every aggregation in the project is within ONE pool (verified: SPECIAL_CONFIGS in scripts/fuse_detections_wbf.py).

n_passes.description: How many passes of proposer_pool were consumed (the prefix length, e.g. consensus-n5 → 5).

source_pass_ids.description: OPTIONAL explicit list of pass foreign keys. Only needed for the rare non-prefix selection; normally the (proposer_pool, n_passes) prefix is sufficient.

vote_threshold.description: Consensus vote threshold (votes a candidate needs to survive).

verifier_config.description: Verifier variant, scale, calibration pool, instruction file — null where there is no verifier stage.

scope_override.description: As-evaluated scope when it diverges from the run's nominal scope (rare, ~2%, e.g. a bounds-filtered companion). Null/absent means the run's scope applies.

metrics.description: Two-part metrics: per-buffer DETECTION metrics, plus a single buffer-agnostic TILE-CLASSIFICATION block. MCC lives once at the tile level (per the project's MCC-always preference), NOT repeated per buffer.

per_buffer.description: Detection metrics keyed by buffer radius in metres. Canonical set is 20/30/40/50 m; finer/larger/intermediate buffers may be added deliberately (recomputation is cheap and local).

bufferMetrics.description: Detection F1/precision/recall at one buffer radius, with a bootstrap CI and a coverage/reliability block for sparse cross-grids.

ci.description: CI on F1 (the headline detection metric).

coverage.description: Fraction of the scope actually evaluated (for sparse cross-grid cells).

ci_unreliable.description: Flag set when sparse coverage makes the CI untrustworthy.

tileClassification.description: Buffer-agnostic tile-level classification. MCC ALWAYS present (per standing preference), even where cross-scope tile-matching gymnastics are required.
